_doc: Per-route allowlisted noise for scripts/qa-sweep.mjs. Anything not listed is a finding; prune entries that stop appearing. Three channels: 'console' (console/page errors), 'network' (4xx/5xx), 'text' (garbage-text / raw-i18n-key / raw-math probes). A waiver is a claim that the noise is understood — always give a reason.

console.reason: apps/admin ships no favicon, so every admin page logs one 404. Tracked as a polish issue; not worth failing all 66 admin cells. Console entries carry no HTTP status, so this matches on the URL.

recharts ResponsiveContainer logs this on first paint before the container is measured. Verified against docs/qa/screenshots/sweep/admin_dashboard_ADMIN_light-1440.png: every chart renders correctly with real data. Dev-time transient, not a defect — do NOT re-file.

network.reason: F3 — summary not yet generated on first load; benign

text.reason: The AI tutor teaches programming and maths, so it renders 'NaN' as correct prose (e.g. 'NaN (Not a Number) tushunchasi'). Everywhere else NaN in the DOM is a real formatting bug, so this waiver is scoped to the tutor route only. Bare 'undefined' is already report-only globally for the same reason.
